newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALTAMERI BUYS KAITOS FOR FIM 2.85 MLN.
newsitem.headline: VALTAMERI BUYS KAITOS FOR FIM 2.85 MLN.

text.p: Finnish trading house Valtameri Oy said on Wednesday it had acquired environment technology company Kaitos Oy for 2.85 million markka.
Valatmeri announced last Friday it had purchased Kaitos but at that time it gave no sum.
Kaitos' business is importing, sales and assembling of geosynthetic materials for environmental, land and water construction.
The deals will not have any major impact on Valtameri's earnings in the financial year ending on April 30, 1997, Valtameri said last Friday.
